app.name: Waseet
app.sandboxNotice: PayPal sandbox — no real money moves.

stateMeaning.DRAFT: Waiting for both parties to confirm the checklist
stateMeaning.DELIVERED: The seller has submitted their work
stateMeaning.VERIFYING: The AI is checking the work against the checklist

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Escrow that pays out when the work is actually done.
login.failed: The email or password is incorrect.
login.unreachable: Could not reach the Waseet server. Is the backend running?
login.demoHint: Demo accounts are listed in the README.

deals.title: Your deals
deals.emptyBuyer: Create a deal to get started — the AI will draft the acceptance checklist.
deals.emptySeller: Nothing here yet. A buyer needs to create a deal naming you as the seller.
deals.emptyReviewer: No disputes to review. Nothing is waiting on you.

create.title: New deal
create.subtitle: Describe the work in plain language. The AI turns it into a checklist both of you confirm before any money moves.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Design a logo for a coffee shop, delivered as a vector file with a transparent background.
create.descriptionHint: At least 20 characters. The more concrete you are, the sharper the checklist.
create.submitting: The AI is drafting the checklist…
create.aiUnavailable: The AI could not draft a checklist right now. Nothing was created — try again.

criteria.title: Acceptance checklist
criteria.subtitle: Drafted by AI from the description. Both of you confirm it before the deal is funded.
criteria.waitingForOther: Waiting for the other party to confirm
criteria.bothConfirmed: Both parties confirmed — the deal can be funded.
criteria.empty: No criteria were drafted for this deal.

funding.title: Fund the escrow
funding.subtitle: Your payment is captured into the platform account and held until the work is verified.
funding.funded: Funded. The money is held in escrow.
funding.failed: The payment could not be completed.
funding.cancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
funding.notConfirmed: Both parties must confirm the checklist before funding.
funding.sdkFailed: PayPal checkout could not load. Check your connection and try again.

deliverable.title: Submit your work
deliverable.subtitle: The AI checks this against the confirmed checklist.
deliverable.contentPlaceholderText: Describe or paste what you are delivering.
deliverable.waitingForFunding: The buyer has not funded this deal yet.

verification.title: Verification report
verification.running: The AI is checking the work
verification.runningDetail: This takes a few seconds. The report appears here when it is done.
verification.advisory: This verdict is produced by an AI verifier and is advisory. Either party can contest it, and a human reviewer resolves any dispute.
verification.autoReleased: Checklist met with high confidence — the funds were released automatically.
verification.disputed: This deal went to a human reviewer rather than paying out.
verification.none: This deal has not been verified yet.
verification.loadFailed: Could not load the verification report.
verification.contestSubtitle: This opens a dispute. The money stays in escrow and a human reviewer decides.

dispute.title: Dispute
dispute.recommendationFailed: Could not get a recommendation. You can still decide.
dispute.advisory: This is an AI recommendation for the reviewer. The reviewer makes the final decision and only that decision moves money.

actionHints.release: Pays the full amount to the seller.
actionHints.refund: Returns the full amount to the buyer.
actionHints.split: Pays the seller a part; the rest returns to the buyer.

dispute.sellerAmountHint: Must be more than zero and less than {amount}.
dispute.reasoningHint: Stored on the deal. Both parties can read it.
dispute.waitingForReviewer: A human reviewer is looking at this deal.

nextSteps.waitingOtherParty: Waiting for the other party to confirm the checklist.
nextSteps.fund: Fund the escrow to start the work.
nextSteps.waitingForFunding: Waiting for the buyer to fund the escrow.
nextSteps.waitingForDelivery: Waiting for the seller to submit their work.
nextSteps.verifying: The AI is checking the work.
nextSteps.reviewerDeciding: A human reviewer is deciding the outcome.

deal.notFound: This deal does not exist, or you are not a party to it.

validation.descriptionShort: Describe the work in at least 20 characters
validation.amountRange: The amount must be between 1 and 10,000
validation.amountDecimals: Use at most two decimal places
validation.contentRequired: Add the link or content you are delivering
validation.reasonRequired: Say why, so the other party and the reviewer can read it
validation.sellerAmountRange: Must be more than 0 and less than the deal amount
